name: DataLink
shortDescription: Provides secure database access for PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQLite with built-in safety features.

rawRecord.name: DataLink
rawRecord.short_description: Provides secure database access for PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQLite with built-in safety features.
rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Enables AI assistants to interact with PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQLite databases through a secure interface. Features prepared statements to prevent SQL injection, DDL blocking to protect schema integrity, configurable read-only mode, and output limits. Supports environment variable substitution for connection URLs.
